title: Cybersecurity Data Sources for Dynamic Network Research
method: Comprehensive logging of authentication process DNS NetFlow and red-team attacks over 58 days
evaluation: Ground truth evaluation of 749 red-team events across 12K+ users and 17K+ computers
main_contribution: Introduced the landmark public multi-source enterprise cyber dataset with confirmed red-team annotations
limitation: High class imbalance (>99.99% benign) and anonymized identifiers without payload inspection
difference_from_our_project: Our work develops an executable multi-agent SOC investigation architecture on top of this dataset.

title: Security Event Correlation for Malicious Activity Detection
dataset: Synthesized enterprise testbed with Botnet traffic
method: Multi-stage correlation engine linking alert sequences into attack steps
evaluation: Evaluated precision recall and false alarm rate on multi-step attacks
main_contribution: Demonstrated that temporal-entity correlation reduces false alerts by over 85%
limitation: Relies on predefined static attack progression templates; fragile against novel attack patterns
difference_from_our_project: Our system uses collaborative autonomous agents with dynamic risk-confidence scoring and uncertainty accounting.

title: Dynamic Log-Based Alert Clustering for Autonomous SOC Operations
dataset: AIT Log Dataset and simulated SIEM logs
method: Agglomerative clustering and sliding temporal windows for log grouping
evaluation: Evaluated alert compression ratio and cluster purity across network attacks
main_contribution: Showed that sliding-window alert clustering dramatically reduces alert fatigue in SOCs
limitation: Does not provide explainable investigation narratives or automated containment playbooks
difference_from_our_project: Our work introduces specialist agents for each domain plus an explainable Analysis and human-approved Response agent.

title: Towards Autonomous Security Operations Centers: A Multi-Agent System Perspective
method: Hierarchical multi-agent architectures for alert triage correlation and remediation
evaluation: Systematic taxonomy of autonomous cyber defense capabilities
main_contribution: Formalized the division of labor between specialized detection agents and coordinating meta-agents
limitation: Lacked reproducible empirical benchmark on large-scale enterprise ground-truth datasets
difference_from_our_project: Our project provides a fully implemented executable multi-agent implementation evaluated directly on the LANL dataset.

title: LLMs as Autonomous Agents for Cyber Defense and Incident Response
venue: ACM CCS Workshop on AI for Security
dataset: Synthetic CTF and cloud security telemetry
method: Large Language Model prompt orchestration for vulnerability analysis and triage
evaluation: Qualitative inspection of incident explanation accuracy and tool-use fidelity
main_contribution: Demonstrated that agentic LLM workflows can generate coherent threat timelines and hypotheses
limitation: Prone to hallucination non-deterministic scoring and high inference latency in production SOCs
difference_from_our_project: Our core multi-agent system uses deterministic explainable risk and confidence scoring with optional LLM narrative layers.

title: Agentic Workflows for Enterprise SOC Incident Triage: Opportunities and Bottlenecks
dataset: Enterprise SIEM telemetry and MITRE ATT&CK evaluations
method: Multi-agent coordination using role-based specialist agents (Network Host Identity)
evaluation: Evaluation of mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR)
main_contribution: Showed that modular agent architectures reduce SOC analyst investigation time by 60%
limitation: High computational overhead and reliance on external cloud APIs for each decision
difference_from_our_project: Our architecture is fully executable locally without cloud dependencies and evaluates rigorous ablation across all agents.

title: Automated Multi-Source Cyber Incident Correlation via Graph Neural Networks
method: Heterogeneous graph modeling and temporal edge embeddings for cyber logs
evaluation: Precision recall and graph clustering metrics on APT lateral movement
main_contribution: Achieved high precision in detecting complex multi-hop lateral movement chains
limitation: Black-box deep learning model lacks transparent explainability and actionable analyst playbooks
difference_from_our_project: Our architecture utilizes explainable specialist agents with transparent mathematical scoring and mandatory human governance.
